stem: New seedlings are stretching and falling over soon after emergence while the root zone stays excessively wet. Which response is most appropriate?
choices: Increase nutrient strength first because weak stems after emergence commonly indicate insufficient mineral supply.
Evaluate light, airflow, moisture management, temperature, and sanitation together rather than correcting only one visible symptom.
Keep the medium wetter for several more days because newly emerged seedlings benefit from continuous saturation while roots establish.
Reduce the light period immediately because stretching and stem collapse are most likely caused by excessive daily light exposure.
rationale: Early establishment failures can involve interacting environmental and disease risks. A multi-factor, traceable assessment is more defensible than a single-cause assumption.
